restrictions: Two-block ordinary collision attack of Li, Liu, Wang, Dong and Sun (ASIACRYPT 2024): time 2^40.5, memory 2^19.8 (tables), on 31-step SHA-256 from the standard IV.
The published colliding pair is attached as a hash-collision-witness-v2 certificate verified by the organizer verifier.
Success probability 0.6 at the stated expected work (geometric trials).

heuristics.statement: The source time complexity 2^40.5 (with 2^19.8 memory) for its 31-step two-block attack holds as stated: the per-trial success rates of its first-block and second-block phases are those of the source analysis.
heuristics.scope: The cited attack of ASIACRYPT 2024 (Li, Liu, Wang, Dong, Sun), applied to this exact target (standard IV, full message, all digest bits).
heuristics.extrapolation: The source found a real colliding pair in 1.2 hours on 64 threads, consistent with 2^40.5; that pair is attached as a verified certificate.
heuristics.limitations: The probability estimates are the source's (standard independence assumptions); this package re-prices but does not re-derive them.
